replay.note: the advocates' outputs were replayed from an earlier run and not regenerated by this one: only the judge was called, so the figures here measure the judge's behaviour on fixed inputs and not the whole pipeline

ruling.explanation:
This is a route-deviation dispute over a Tampines-to-one-north trip charged at SGD 43.41. Both sides largely agree on the facts, and the disagreement is only about how much of the diversion the driver must answer for.

FIRST, THE DEVIATION. The governing distance is the trace, not the rounded trip-record copy. EV-GPS-00104 (weight 1.0, 283 fixes, 10-second sampling, 100% coverage, zero gaps) measures 34.17 km against a booked optimal of 27.1 km (EV-TRIP-00104, weight 1.0): an excess of 7.07 km, or 26.09%. Under POL-RD-01 both establishment tests pass (over 20% of optimal and over 0.8 km), so a deviation IS established on this trip's own trace. It is not a MATERIAL deviation (under 50% and under 8.0 km). The rider's core point is accepted.

SECOND, THE DRIVER'S EXCUSE. The LTA DataMall advisory ADV-20260716-007 (EV-ADVIS-00104-01, weight 1.0) names the PIE towards Tuas after the Eunos Link exit, a segment the optimal route uses; its window 20:02-21:35 straddles the trip with buffer to spare; and the trace leaves the PIE at Bedok North Ave 4 ahead of the blocked stretch and rejoins on the AYE. POL-RD-03 exoneration therefore applies - but only within its cap: min(7.07, 1.30 x (30.1 - 27.1) + 1.00) = min(7.07, 4.90) = 4.90 km. So 4.90 km is excused and 2.17 km is not. The driver's assertion that the whole diversion was unavoidable is rejected. His reliance on the second, CTE advisory EV-ADVIS-00104-02 (weight 0.25; issues ADVISORY_UNCORROBORATED and UNVERIFIED_SOURCE; geometry on a corridor this trip never enters) is also rejected - that artifact carries no part of the decision and does not lower confidence, and is named here as POL-GEN-02(3) requires.

THIRD, THE CHAT LOG. EV-CHAT-00104 (weight 1.0) does not move the excess onto the rider. POL-RD-04 needs a specific rider instruction naming a place or road; here the driver proposed the diversion and the rider only replied 'ok but not too long ah', with waypoint_hint null. No rider instruction exists, so none of the excess is re-attributed to the rider, and the acknowledgment is not consent to a run down to Marina and the AYE.

FOURTH, THE MONEY. fare_model is METERED with surge 1.0 read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, so POL-RD-11 does not apply and POL-RD-02 governs. The closure-adjusted optimal is 27.1 + 4.90 = 32.0 km, duration 34.0 x (32.0 / 27.1) = 40.1 min (amended_optimal_duration_min is null). recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 32.0 + 0.28 x 40.1) x 1.0) + 0.80 = 39.828, with no ERP, tolls, surcharge, waiting fee or promo to add. charged_total = 43.41, so the refund is 43.41 - 39.828 = 3.582, rounded up to SGD 3.60. That is above the 0.50 de minimis and well under 90% of charged_total, so this is a PARTIAL_REFUND, not a full one.

FIFTH, THE REMAINING POINTS. No driver compensation: the fare was billed on 34.2 km, which is not less than the 34.17 km trace, so POL-RD-04's unbilled-distance limb never arises. POL-RD-09 adds nothing - no ERP gantries, no tolls, no airport surcharge (the trip does not originate at an airport) and no phantom line; the fare lines reconcile to the cent. POL-RD-06: deviation_flags_90d is 1 against 288 completed trips (0.0035), far below both thresholds, so no pattern is established - no FULL_REFUND uplift and no conduct referral. POL-RD-07: the trace is clean, no integrity limb fires. POL-RD-10: no escalation trigger fires - identifiers match across all three core artifacts, the trace is unimpaired, no exculpatory clause is invoked against a missing or out-of-window artifact, the refund is far below SGD 150, and every charge line has a counterpart. No claim was discarded at the citation stage.
